description_en: Removes a unit node from a global active database cluster
description_zh: 该接口用于移除RDS全球多活数据库集群中的单元节点
kebab_example: aliyun rds detach-gad-instance-member --gad-instance-name gad-rm-bp1npi2j80000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --member-instance-name rm-bp1npi2j80000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DetachGadInstanceMember

parameters.help_en: The ID of the global active database cluster
parameters.name: gad_instance_name

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the central node. You can call the DescribeGadInstances operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh: 集群中心节点所在的地域ID。可调用DescribeGadInstances查询
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance that serves as the unit node you want to remove. You can call the DescribeGadInstances query the instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 需要移除的单元节点的RDS实例ID，可调用DescribeGadInstances查询
parameters.name: member_instance_name

parameters.help_en: The resource group ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstanceAttribute operation to query the resource group ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id
